name: Affine-Transformations Method
definition: A hybrid method that uses affine transformations to warp slices or volumes into the image plane so data samples become pixel-aligned, then composites the transformed data.
summary: The Affine-Transformations Method is a hybrid volume rendering technique that warps volume slices into the image plane using explicit affine parameters to align sampling grids with pixels, distinguishing it from shear-warp or neural warp approaches.
